description: Set up Generator image assets (File > Generate > Image Assets): name layers with asset specs such as "icon.png", "200% hero@2x.png24" or "50x50 thumb.jpg80%" so Generator writes them to a folder next to the PSD, set the document-wide defaults layer ("default 200% @2x/"), and turn Image Assets on or off for the document

name.description: Asset spec, comma-separated, each part ending in .png, .png8, .png24, .png32, .jpg (optionally a quality 1-10 or percent), .gif, .svg or .webp

defaults.description: Document-wide defaults written as an empty layer named "default <defaults>", e.g. "200% @2x/, 50% small/"

toggle.description: Switch Image Assets generation on or off for the document (it is a toggle). Default false

name: generate_image_assets
title: Generate Image Assets
